verdict.rationale: MotherDuck ships a first-party AI assistant ("Dives") that turns natural-language prompts into SQL-backed charts/dashboards and lets users iterate conversationally ("add a filter for US region", "switch to a bar chart"), plus a remote MCP server that lets an agent write, execute, and modify SQL against the user's schemas without the user writing SQL themselves, backed by Guides to keep generated SQL accurate to org schema conventions. This directly matches the story of an in-product AI assistant writing/fixing/explaining SQL from natural language.  missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party validation that Dives/MCP reliably produces correct SQL (community evidence found relates to a different feature, Instant SQL, not to Dives or MCP SQL generation).
